# Server

## Sections

- [block](/scripting/server/block/)
- [entity](/scripting/server/entity/)
- [voice](/scripting/server/voice/)

## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ScramServerCollision`](/scripting/server/ScramServerCollision) | Custom collision of a world: a solid convex shape (box, cylinder, prism, wedge, sphere) that players and other entities collide with like with blocks. |
| [`ScramServerRegion`](/scripting/server/ScramServerRegion) | Named file-backed region from c.getServer().getRegion(id) or c.getWorld().getRegion(id). |
| [`ScramServerSound`](/scripting/server/ScramServerSound) | A sound that can be changed while it plays: moved, faded, made higher or lower, paused, stopped with a fade-out, and heard from the right point by players who come later (see [`sync()`](#sync)). |
| [`ScramServerTrigger`](/scripting/server/ScramServerTrigger) | Named click target from `c.getServer().getTrigger(id)` or `c.getWorld().getTrigger(id)`, saved in the world's triggers.json. |
| [`ScriptServer`](/scripting/server/ScriptServer) | Controls the Minecraft server and its optional voice groups from server scripts. |
| [`ScriptServerContext`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerContext) | Context of a server script function, passed as `c`: the running script and function, the subject and object entities of the event, the world, the server, values given by the event and the result the event reacts to. |
| [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) | A BBS form rendered in the world for selected players, at a world position or relative to an entity. |
| [`ScriptServerRayTrace`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerRayTrace) | Result of a ray trace from `entity.rayTraceBlock`, `entity.rayTraceEntity` or `world.rayTrace`: a hit block, a hit entity or a miss. |
| [`ScriptServerWorld`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerWorld) | A world (dimension) of the server, from `c.getWorld()` or an entity: blocks, entities, regions, collisions, weather, time, sounds, particles and ray traces. |
